description: This Perl script processes and analyzes the output of 'git verify-pack -v', providing statistics and detailed information about git pack files, including sizes, delta chains, delta trees, depths, and optionally filenames and tree structure.
published: main subroutines or symbols if any explicitly exported or indicated in code (none explicitly shown here)

methods.name: stats
methods.description: Calculates statistical metrics (min, max, total, mean, median, standard deviation) for an array of numerical data.

methods.name: print_stats
methods.description: Prints formatted statistical summary using the 'stats' function results.

methods.name: dig
methods.description: Recursively traverses the delta trees, collecting size, path size, and depth information, and printing tree structure if requested.
